A real lazy-load address wins over an inline data src when the payload is not kept

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use HtmlToMarkdown\HtmlToMarkdown;
use HtmlToMarkdown\ConversionOptions;
$options = \HtmlToMarkdown\ConversionOptions::from_json(json_encode(["inlineDataMedia" => "DropElement"]));
$result = HtmlToMarkdown::convert("<p><img src=\"data:image/png;base64,AAAA\" data-src=\"https://example.com/real.png\" alt=\"icon\"></p>", $options);
var_dump($result->content);
```
